page.layout: One title page, all lines centred in one block: the title at the top, the names of the candidates and the printer's line below. No margins, no running head, no page number printed.

main_text.l: S. S. Theol. D. & Prof. P.

page.notes: Handwritten "15" at the top right and a handwritten "2" beside it are manuscript marks, not printed, and are left out. A faint reddish mark at the left edge, level with "Propugnabunt", is a stain or stamp and is left out. The Greek phrase "κατὰ δύναμιν" is read from a small italic line and the accents are uncertain; it is not marked with [?] because the reading is the usual phrase, but the letters should be checked against the scan. The "Die Sept." line is in small italic type and "H. L. Q.S." is kept as printed. The date line is printed in spaced capitals with stops, as shown. No engraving is present.
